g.text: DoN 0.85 · where the paired benchmark outcomes diverge
All 50 trials per controller. Markers show actual stopped robot centers; overlapping markers are not jittered.
First-corner ROI: stopped center x ∈ [0, 0.20] m and y ∈ [0.45, 0.65] m. SF: 16 first-corner failures + 2 later failures + 32 goals. MF: 0 + 5 + 45.
The recorded center reaches x ≥ 0.20 m in 34/50 SF trials and 50/50 MF trials. All later failures occur after that crossing; this is not a whole-footprint passage definition.

Observed locations and outcomes establish a spatial difference; they do not isolate feature coverage, slack, or solver linearization as its cause. Successful runs are not treated as censored failures.
